resources.name: Crystal structure of PPV-CaPtO3 (Cmcm)

access.notes: Experimental structure from Jung & Oganov, Phys. Chem. Miner. 32, 146 (2005). Lattice parameters and atomic positions are provided in the paper.

resources.notes: Starting structure for the PPV phase used in geometry optimization.

resources.name: Crystal structure of PV-CaIrO3 (Pbnm) for deriving hypothetical PV-CaPtO3

access.notes: Stølen & Tronnes, Phys. Earth Planet. Inter. 164, 50 (2007). The PV-CaPtO3 structure is derived from this isostructural CaIrO3 perovskite; replacing Ir with Pt and relaxing yields the initial geometry.

resources.notes: The atomic positions of the hypothetical PV-CaPtO3 are constructed by substituting Pt into the CaIrO3 perovskite lattice.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave pseudopotential DFT code. All DFT calculations (optimization, E(V) scans, band structure) are performed with this code.

resources.notes: Used as the open-source equivalent of VASP. The agent should select an appropriate LDA pseudopotential library (e.g., SSSP or PseudoDojo).

resources.name: LDA pseudopotentials for Ca, Pt, O

access.notes: Standard LDA pseudopotentials from the Quantum ESPRESSO website or the SSSP library.

resources.notes: Required to perform LDA calculations as in the paper.

resources.name: Birch-Murnaghan equation of state fitting utility

access.notes: The agent must fit the E(V) data to a second-order Birch-Murnaghan equation to extract V0 and B0. This can be done with a standard Python scientific stack.

resources.notes: The agent may implement the fit using scipy.optimize.curve_fit or a dedicated library.
